title: How One Weekly Question Keeps a Godly Man Walking Humbly
caption:
One weekly question keeps a godly man walking humbly.

Micah 6:8 in one habit, not just one verse.

He has shown you, O man, what is good. And what does the Lord require of you? To act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with your God (Micah 6:8). Walking humbly isn't a feeling you wait on. It's a question you actually ask.

Sunday night, before you plan the week: where did I want credit this week? Say the answer out loud to a brother, not just a journal. Then let the small stuff, the sink, the credit you don't take, do the rest.
